A little gratitude.

Photography makes this journey possible. All photographs are from Unsplash, downloaded and optimized for this educational project under the Unsplash License. Copyright remains with the photographers.

Photography

  • Dario Veronesi — hero-rome ↗

    Colosseum close-up, orange sunset, landscape. Dark dramatic hero or Rome card.

  • Yilei (Jerry) Bao — skyline ↗

    Rome skyline and domes at sunset. Preferred wide hero; room in sky for typography.

  • Ivan Bertona — trevi ↗

    Trevi Fountain illuminated in warm golden light. Landscape.

  • Giuseppe Mondì — florence ↗

    Florence skyline with Duomo and trees, warm daylight. Portrait; crop center for cards.

  • Robert Bye — tuscany ↗

    Tuscan chapel and farmhouse across golden fields. Portrait; center crop retains buildings.

  • Damiano Baschiera — venice ↗

    Rialto Bridge with gondola on Grand Canal, teal water and warm architecture. Portrait.

  • VFP Fineart — gondola ↗

    Gondola in narrow Venetian canal, cinematic muted colors. Portrait.

  • Ross Parmly — flight ↗

    Airplane wing amid sunset clouds. Landscape, suitable transport section.

  • Eaters Collective — pasta ↗

    Italian-style ribbon pasta with mushrooms and greens. Shot in Toronto; use as illustrative cuisine, not an actual Italian restaurant location.

  • Dan Novac — venice-wide ↗

    Horizontal Grand Canal looking toward Santa Maria della Salute; full bleed ready.

  • Jonathan Körner — florence-wide ↗

    Horizontal Florence Duomo panorama with terracotta roofs and mountains; full bleed ready.
